```{r}
#| label: params-check
#| echo: false

message("Lifestage setting: ", params$Lifestage)
message("Population mode: ", params$Population)
message("Study: ", params$Test_study)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-pakages
#| code-summary: "Packages"
#| message: false
#| include: false

  library(here)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(glue)
  library(patchwork) 
  library(DT)
  library(plotly)
  library(showtext)
  font_add(family = "Garamond", regular = "GARA.TTF")
  showtext_auto()
  
  if (params$Population == "Yes") {
  load(here("Output", "Pers.POST.RUN_RESULTS.RData"))
  load(here("Output", "Pop.POST.RUN_RESULTS.RData"))
  } else {
  load(here("Output", "Pers.POST.RUN_RESULTS.RData"))
    }

```

# PBK Results summary

```{r}
#| label: Summary
#| echo: false

  if (params$Population == "Yes") {
  Data_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(Pers.POST.RUN_RESULTS, function(x) x$ANALYSED_data))
  } else {
  Data_summary <- Pers.POST.RUN_RESULTS$ANALYSED_data
    }


datatable(Data_summary, 
              options = list(pageLength = 10, 
                             scrollX = TRUE, 
                             scrollY = "50vh",
                             scrollCollapse = TRUE))

```
